_doc: The day/night cycle (scripts/match/day_night.gd, docs/SPAWNS.md). It runs on the session clock: phase_s seconds of day, then phase_s of night, and so on, starting in day. phase_s is for a ref_session_s session and scales with the real session (a 720 s match gets 120 s phases). ramp: share of a phase the light takes to turn (centred on the swap). warn_s: seconds of warning before night spawns appear (a second call 10 s before). night_share / day_share: share of the Camps and Small Camps (never Great Camps) that stand only at night / only by day, picked by their spot alone like the camps' monsters. night_mix: what a night camp holds (by camp size, one list per spot's dice). boss: a night elite at one fixed outer-island spot per night, picked from the match seed and shown on the full map from the start.
